mn-sos-2026-general-statecounty.title: Candidates in the General Election: Federal, State, and County Offices (November 3, 2026)
mn-sos-2026-general-statecounty.note: Saved by hand from the Secretary of State's candidate site, which admits people rather than scripts: MN_Candidates in the General Election - Federal, State, and County Offices_20261103.md. Read: name, office ID, office title, county ID, the party order code and party. Addresses, cities, ZIP codes, phones, e-mail and running mates' contact details are never read; the campaign website a candidate listed is read apart. U.S. Senator and U.S. Representative rows are left to the federal pages. In a partisan race the ballot order is each candidate's rank by the party order code the file gives; nonpartisan candidates all carry the code 90, so the file gives no ballot position for them.

mn-sos-2026-general-local.title: Candidates in the General Election: Local Offices (Municipal, School, and Hospital District) (November 3, 2026)
mn-sos-2026-general-local.note: Saved by hand from the Secretary of State's candidate site: MN_Candidates in the General Election - Local Offices (Municipal, School, and Hospital District)_20261103.md. Read: office code, name, office ID, office title, county ID, MCD FIPS code and school district number. Every local office is nonpartisan; the file gives no ballot position. Addresses, cities, ZIP codes, phones and e-mail are never read; the campaign website a candidate listed is read apart.

mn-sos-2026-filings-statecounty.title: Candidate Filings: Federal, State, and County Offices (2026)
mn-sos-2026-filings-statecounty.note: Saved by hand from the same site: MN_Candidate Filings - Federal, State, and County Offices_20261103.md. Used only for the August 11 partisan primaries (statewide offices and the Legislature): everyone who filed for a party that two or more filed for. The one on the November list is marked as having advanced and the rest as having lost (which also covers anyone who withdrew); votes wait for the official results files. Read: name, office ID, office title, county ID and party; contact details are never read.

mn-mde-school-districts-2025-26.title: School District Boundaries, Minnesota, SY2025-26
mn-mde-school-districts-2025-26.note: School district numbers, types and names. Counties each school district reaches: its boundary (Department of Education, SY2025-26, generalised to 50 m) laid over the Secretary of State's precincts on a 100-metre grid, counting only cells more than 200 metres inside a county (at least 1); 187 thinner touches along county lines were set aside. The Secretary's own county for a district is always kept. Analysis, not an official list.
